Root viewport canvas/final transform integration is audited against pinned viewport.cpp, canvas_item.cpp and window.cpp. CanvasCoordinateTests verifies composition, defaults, non-stored descriptors, inverse/owner/lifetime errors and event ownership; CanvasCoordinateRenderingTests verifies native Wayland GPU/compatibility and dummy pixels, injected mouse input, HLSL/GLSL and allocation. Camera and CanvasLayer now have separate runtime audits; root content stretch, embedded viewport containers and non-root GUI remain missing integrations; independent single-layer SubViewport transforms now execute (ADRs 0008, 0028, 0038); other native platforms and successful pointer warping are unverified. CanvasItem screen coordinates retain explicit Wayland desktop-position rejection. Direct popup injection retains acceptance/cancellation after localization while bypassing its own WindowInput event; only the final nested popup applies this policy. WindowInputTests covers direct/forwarded cancellation, disabled GUI, exact signal counts, nested ownership and reception edits; ColorPickerTests covers focused text commitment and cancellation restoration. This correction does not promote the remaining viewport gaps.

ADRs 0008/0038/0040/0083: all thirteen embedded Window theme entries execute through typed Window lookup and borrowed defaults/resources. Focused/unfocused style boxes draw against the content rectangle with their own expansion; shaped centered LTR/RTL titles consume the resolved font/size/color/outline; real normal/pressed icons use theme offsets and independent visual dimensions. Captured close commits only on release inside the original normal-icon rectangle, with outside/focus/hide/policy/lifetime cancellation; external resize margins preserve constrained opposite edges. Decoration queries use the maximum focused/unfocused content metrics. Managed and fresh-process custom theme scenes, native injected pointer/focus transitions, GPU/compatibility pixel captures and 64 prepared active theme/redraw/render frames with zero managed owner bytes verify Linux. Independent native children, OS titlebar policies, foreign platforms, physical input acceptance and native allocator totals remain separate gates.
